pull_request.title: Tracker: add stacked tracker material profiles with unrooted
pull_request.head: codex/geantino-material-stacks
pull_request.body:
## Executive summary

Add stacked material-budget profiles for the existing 100,000-geantino tracker scan using unrooted. Split beam pipe, pixel, short strip and long strip into sensitive/non-sensitive contributions, with radiation- and interaction-length profiles versus eta, |eta| and phi plus individual subdetector panels.

## Change

Add portable classification/export/plotting scripts, compact bin data, CSV and PNG/PDF/SVG figures, a retained scientific report, tracking and session records. Figures regenerate from compact data without the 698 MB recording or native DD4hep runtime; HTML and ROOT outputs stay generated-only. CI replays the figures and checks float32 boundary cells.

Recover sensitivity from an explicitly selected DD4hep geometry, preserving passive silicon ASICs, guards and seams. Every geantino fills every component, including zero contributions. Total errors come from per-track totals and include component covariance. Six precision rescues include two microscopic sensitivity-edge ambiguities; the known eta-bin allocation bound is below 1.5e-10 X0. The original recording geometry revision, seed and command remain unknown, and the report states the limits of density matching and the finite search grid.

[Figures and method report](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/geantino-material-stacks/docs/validation/geantino-material-profiles/README.md). Governing records: DES-024/025 and ADR-008; follows the unrooted setup from issue #95 and PR #96. No detector geometry or design-approval states change.

## Validation

- Corrected-source full native rerun: all 100,000 tracks / 17,137,021 steps assigned, zero density mismatches.
- All 54 native profiles independently verified against per-track reductions; exact equality with every retained edge, count, component/total mean and variance.
- Portable replay produces 15 plot artifacts; static figures visually checked.
- C++ rounding-cell regression passes locally and under the separate PhysVal check with strict compiler warnings.
- Separate fixed-revision PhysVal assessments; provenance and rounding-cell findings resolved, with reports retained.
- 33 session tests and project/session/interaction/token validators pass locally. Hosted checks run on push.

## Review checklist

- [x] Project tracking and validation evidence updated.
- [x] Human approval boundaries preserved; no detector sign-off claimed.
- [x] Layout geometry is unchanged, so no R–Z regeneration is required.
- [x] Recovered three completed turns: 7,314,037 input + 42,419 output = 7,356,456 tokens (67 requests). Active PR/accounting turn excluded; cache/reasoning subsets not added.
- [x] PR-specific interaction record retains refreshed public discussion, completed visible turns, active visible discussion, parent/child attribution and canonical usage references.

The accounting update also preserves explicit parent metadata for completed child discussions when the parent turn is still active; its regression prevents misattributing an agent assignment as human input.

events.text:
GEANTINO-PhysVal-01 reviewed **`4008abf1c4c76bbfd5f7df64dcfd81ee5e62e768`**, using the supplied generic-agent PhysVal mandate. No files changed, native simulations run, packages activated/installed, external services contacted or further agents spawned.

The normalization and statistical treatment are technically sound for this retained scan. The supplemental native rerun resolves the principal provenance finding.

- **P2 — Original evidence does not identify the packaged classifier. Resolved by supplemental evidence.** Pinned `provenance.json:18–24` records classifier/launcher hashes `79c9c252…` and `97400b2d…`; committed sources hash to `f6de3bb0…` and `81dd4165…`. The new working-tree `native-rerun.json`, SHA-256 `7a884c9ec38eb36a7c331410dd4045993f20732ba89facb7a53fdc4d30a30560`, explicitly identifies the reviewed commit and matching source/input hashes. I independently checked its actual ROOT output against the pinned retained profiles and confirmed the numerical correspondence. Preserve this correction separately from the original provenance.

- **P3 — The rounding-cell implementation slightly exceeds the true cell at floating-point binade boundaries.** `categorize.C:140–142` uses half the **maximum** adjacent float spacing symmetrically. At float32 `128`, the true rounding interval is approximately `[127.9999961853, 128.0000076294]`, whereas the implemented interval begins at `127.9999923706`. Thus “Never enlarge the rounding cell” at line 134 is not universally satisfied. Use separate lower/upper midpoint bounds when generalizing this classifier. None of the six retained rescue coordinates is near this case, so this does not invalidate the reviewed scan.

Assessment of the requested claims:

| Claim | Assessment and evidence |
|---|---|
| Per-geantino means include zeros | Correct: totals reset per track and every component receives one fill, `categorize.C:95–98,225–229`. Supplemental native counts independently confirm the common denominator. |
| Sensitive/passive attribution | Correct implementation of reconstructed DD4hep flags, `categorize.C:194–205`. Silicon composition alone does not set sensitivity. Attribution remains conditional on the reconstructed geometry matching the original recording. |
| Pre-step convention | The implementation consistently uses `position + fraction × length × direction`, `categorize.C:107–111`. I did not independently establish the unidentified original recording writer’s version. |
| Covariance-aware total errors | Correct: the total is formed per track before profile filling. `export_profiles.py:41–60` independently reduces total samples. Component variances are not added for the plotted total band. |
| Precision rescues and bound | The two detected sensitivity ambiguities retain their complete budgets, `categorize.C:167–177`. I independently reproduced all six reported maximum-bin bounds from categorized tracks. These bound the identified ambiguous contributions; the finite grid is not an exhaustive uncertainty bound over all possible positions or geometry identities. |
| Scientific interpretation | Appropriately limited to material characterization. Statistical SEM does not measure detector-model, original-geometry identity, response or reconstruction uncertainty; the README states this distinction. |

Actual checks:

- Read the six pinned inputs through Git, plus committed launcher, analysis instructions, classification inventory, diagnostics and validation manifest.
- Parsed all retained profile arrays: finite nonnegative values/variances, ordered edges, common counts, weighted component means and additive totals passed.
- All axes contain 100,000 tracks; minimum occupancies are **1,036 / 2,124 / 1,300**.
- All six pinned CSVs correspond numerically to `profiles.json`; all 12 retained figures match the original artifact hashes.
- Independently reread the coordinator’s supplemental native ROOT output using the existing sibling Python environment. All **54 profiles** exactly match pinned edges, counts, means and variances. Independent per-track means and population SEM calculations passed.
- Per-track closure passed the specified tolerances; maxima remain **5.77047e-6 X0** and **1.22651e-6 interaction lengths**.
- Ambiguous track entries are **47,872** and **86,513**. Their maximum eta-bin shifts reproduce **1.45946e-10 X0** and **2.99372e-11 interaction lengths**.

No remaining blocking issue was found for the narrowly stated reduction after retaining the supplemental provenance correction. Original generator seed/command and recording geometry revision remain unknown; density agreement cannot establish identical same-density material recipes or sensitive boundaries. This is a technical recommendation, not design acceptance or human scientific sign-off.

events.text:
GEANTINO-PhysVal-02 reviewed **`7c0012184a6bb033eb4366d48db4f8699b22f8d5`**. Both previous findings are resolved within this follow-up’s scope.

- **P3 fixed:** `rounding_cell.h` calculates lower and upper half-neighbor spacings separately. `categorize.C` selects the corresponding width for each signed grid offset. This resolves the excessive search extent at positive and negative powers of two.
- **P2 fixed:** committed `native-rerun-4008abf.json` preserves the separately identified earlier rerun. Its classifier and launcher hashes match their exact `4008abf1c4c76bbfd5f7df64dcfd81ee5e62e768` sources. The report’s hash remains `7a884c9ec38eb36a7c331410dd4045993f20732ba89facb7a53fdc4d30a30560`; it is the evidence independently checked during GEANTINO-PhysVal-01.
- **Correction provenance supported:** the updated launcher adds the header’s include directory and records `rounding_cell.h` alongside classifier and launcher hashes.

Actual checks:

- Read all five assigned inputs from the exact commit and verified their supplied SHA-256 values.
- Compiled the exact committed regression using `clang++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror`, with assertions enabled; execution **passed**.
- Regression checks cover asymmetric widths at **±128**, symmetric widths at **127.5**, subnormal half-widths at **zero**, grid containment and rejection of an infinite coordinate.
- Compilation sources and executable were written only beneath `/private/tmp/GEANTINO-PhysVal-02-4c6s93am`.

No remaining finding arose within the requested correction scope. The corrected-source whole-scan rerun remains coordinator-owned and is **not claimed as passed by this review**. The earlier limits on finite-grid coverage and unknown original recording geometry/seed remain unchanged.

No repository files changed; no native simulation, installation, activation, external access or delegation occurred. This is a technical assessment, not human sign-off.
